One day, an invitation to NekoFes arrives at the patisserie "La Soleil". NekoFes is an event where Nekos and their owners from around the world compete for popularity!
It seems that if you win, you can receive a reward said to ”grant any wish”!? 
The only condition for entry is to hire Neko students from five different academies.
A new story with new friends is about to begin!

La Soleil has won the NekoFes preliminaries, but a misunderstanding occurs between Yuzuha and Mikan due to their abilities, disrupting their sisterly relationship.
This leads to Yuzuha disappearing when she goes back to the academy.
The pâtissier and the others open a new branch at Sakura Hills Nekos College, and as they work to create a place for Yuzuha to come home to, they take part in the next competition with some new friends.

This is an auto-renewing monthly paid service that provides various benefits upon joining.
Once joined, benefits will be active across accounts in different Worlds.

■ Data Linking
Joining is limited to one account per Apple ID / Google Play account.
If data linking is performed, the subscription remains valid on the same account even across different OS platforms until the expiration date.
If you subscribe multiple times using different OS accounts, effects and benefits will not stack.

■ Cancellation (Disabling Auto-Renewal)
Subscriptions can be canceled through your respective OS store settings.
After disabling auto-renewal, the subscription will become invalid once the current validity period ends.

■ Important Notes
This is an auto-renewing monthly paid service.
Please note that refunds and returns are not available.
The validity period is one month from the date of purchase or auto-renewal.
The validity period will automatically renew every month.
Unless auto-renewal is disabled, the period will be renewed automatically.
Monthly payments will occur due to auto-renewal.
Delays may occur during processing on the day of renewal. If benefits are temporarily inactive, please wait a moment and try reloading.
To cancel, please disable auto-renewal at least 48 hours before the validity period ends.
Benefits remain active until the end of the period even if canceled midway.
The subscription is only valid for the app account in use at the time of joining.
Please note that you cannot join with a new subscription on a different platform until the current period expires.
If you create a new app account (e.g., after deleting the app), benefits cannot be transferred.
If duplicate subscriptions are made, effects and benefits will not stack. We cannot accept cancellations of payments regarding duplicate subscriptions.
There may be a short delay between the end of the validity period and the actual deactivation of benefits.
Please note that auto-renewal will continue even if the app is deleted unless the formal cancellation process is completed.
When changing devices to a different OS, or transferring to a different account on the same OS, effects will be carried over for the remainder of the period.
Therefore, when joining anew, please ensure you have canceled on your previous platform (or account) first. You cannot join anew until the current validity period has ended.
